title: AzureDevOpsScene props
description: Reusable synthetic Azure DevOps repo, file, pull request, diff, PR Assistant comment, and reviewer activity surface. Use anonymized names and demo data by default.

theme.description: Theme identifier. Currently sky-premium is the built-in look.

pageTitle.description: Page title in the main header.

breadcrumb.description: Breadcrumb text above the page title.

searchPlaceholder.default: Search project, files, work items, or PRs

files.description: Rows for repo file lists. Each row accepts name, path, type, meta, active.

tree.description: Folder tree rows. Each row accepts name, type, indent, active.

codeLines.description: Code viewer lines as strings or objects with number, text, highlight.

fileLocation.description: Display-only folder or repo location for the active file. Avoids Slate asset-path handling for props ending in Path.

diffLines.description: Diff lines. Each row accepts type add/remove/context/hunk, oldNumber, newNumber, text.

checks.description: PR check rows. Each row accepts title, subtitle, status.

reviewers.description: Reviewer rows. Each row accepts name, role, status, initials.

impactRows.description: PR Assistant impact table rows. Each row accepts contract, changedFile, affectedRepo, owner, reason, severity.

recommendations.description: PR Assistant recommendations rendered as compact bullets.

activity.description: Timeline rows for reviewer activity. Each row accepts title, subtitle, status, time.

bodyHtml.description: Raw HTML override for the main body. Use only for tightly controlled bespoke scenes.

sideNavHtml.description: Raw HTML override for the side nav.

tabsHtml.description: Raw HTML override for top tabs.

headerPillsHtml.description: Raw HTML override for header status pills.
